AegisAdmin.addUserSuccess: User created. A verification email has been sent.
AegisAdmin.webhookSecretHint: Share this with your tenant to verify webhook signatures.
AegisAdmin.tenantApiKeyHint: Required server-side on every tenant backend. Set as AEGIS_TENANT_API_KEY env var. Never expose in browser code.
AegisAdmin.regenerateTenantKeyError: Failed to regenerate tenant API key.
AegisAdmin.mailgunDomainHint: Per-site Mailgun sending domain (e.g. mg.tenantcorp.com). Leave blank to use the global default.
AegisAdmin.mailgunApiKeyHint: Per-site Mailgun API key. Leave blank to use the global default.
AegisAdmin.deleteSiteDescription: Permanently delete this site and ALL of its users, tokens, and data. This cannot be undone.
AegisAdmin.deleteSiteModalWarning: This permanently deletes the site and ALL of its users, tokens, and data. This action cannot be undone.
AegisAdmin.deleteSiteConfirmLabel: Type the site domain to confirm:
AegisAdmin.deleteSiteProtectedUsersError: This site has users protected from deletion. Clear their deletion protection via the admin API before deleting the site.
AegisAdmin.deleteSiteProtectedError: This site is protected from deletion. Clearing protection requires an explicit admin API call.
AegisAdmin.siteProtectionOffDescription: Deletion protection is off. When enabled, no user on this site can be deleted and the site itself cannot be deleted — for tenants whose accounts anchor records that could not be recovered or reattributed.
AegisAdmin.siteProtectionOnDescription: Deletion protection is ON. No user on this site can be deleted, and the site itself cannot be deleted. Clearing this requires an explicit admin API call and cannot be done from this console.
AegisAdmin.siteProtectionModalWarning: Every user on this site becomes undeletable, and the site itself cannot be deleted. This cannot be undone from this console — clearing protection requires an explicit admin API call. That is deliberate: this is the safeguard for tenants whose accounts anchor unrecoverable records.
AegisAdmin.deleteUserModalWarning: This permanently deletes the user and all of their tokens and data. This action cannot be undone.
AegisAdmin.deleteUserConfirmLabel: Type the user's email to confirm:
AegisAdmin.deleteUserSelfError: You cannot delete the account you are currently logged in as.
AegisAdmin.deleteUserLastAdminError: You cannot delete the last admin of a site.
AegisAdmin.deleteUserProtectedError: This user is protected from deletion. Deletion protection must be cleared via the admin API before this account can be deleted.
AegisAdmin.deleteUserSiteProtectedError: This entire site is protected from deletion, so none of its users can be deleted. Clearing protection requires an explicit admin API call.
AegisAdmin.protectUserHint: Prevent this account from being deleted.
AegisAdmin.protectUserModalWarning: Deletion of this account will be refused while protection is on. Protection cannot be removed from this console — clearing it requires an explicit admin API call, which is deliberate: this is the safeguard for accounts whose loss would be unrecoverable.
AegisAdmin.deletionProtectedHint: Protected from deletion — downstream records depend on this identity.
